purpose: Candidate retrieval, scoped feature lookup, and concept-graph membership. LLM review decides identity and applicability.

object.definition: The complete loss sequence for $K\ge2$ experts is fixed before interaction, with $\ell_t:[K]\to[0,1]$ each round. Choose $I_t$ before seeing the full current loss vector, without observation noise. Define $$L_\star=\min_{i\in[K]}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\ell_t(i).$$. Neither the best-expert cumulative loss $L_\star$ nor future losses are known.
